quant_model.label: Computed from sourced data · method 2026.10.2 · band: 5th–95th percentile of 500 weight and normalisation draws

components.name: trade_export_share
components.definition: Share of the country's mineral exports (reported to UN Comtrade) that go to the actor.

components.name: trade_import_share
components.definition: Share of the country's mineral imports that come from the actor.

components.name: finance_flow
components.definition: Documented official-finance commitments from the actor's institutions over the last three years, relative to GDP; central-bank swap-line drawdowns excluded.

components.name: debt_stock
components.definition: Public and publicly guaranteed external debt owed to the actor, relative to GDP (World Bank IDS reports China as a creditor; no equivalent source exists for the United States).

components.name: diplomatic_alignment
components.definition: UN General Assembly voting agreement with the actor in the year.

components.name: legislative_stance
components.definition: Mean stance toward the actor (−2 to +2) in the legislature's mineral-related records, years with at least five scored records; a text-model output carried with its validation status.

rules.normalisation: winsorised (2.5–97.5 pct) min–max over the pooled panel, both actors on one scale
rules.weights: equal, renormalised over the available components

concentration.hhi: not computed: partner flows for the United States, China and the world total only

top_lenders.label: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)

regressions.note: country and year fixed effects; regressors standardised (coefficient = share points per 1 SD); CR1 standard errors clustered by country; p_wild from 999 Rademacher wild-cluster draws; jk_min/jk_max = coefficient range dropping one country at a time
